NornCrown.description: The maximum level of <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> is increased by {[effectLevel]}. Other friendly <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range and friendly <style="Summon">Summons</style> within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to enemies that are affected by <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style>.
